{07 06 00}Why would you say that!?
Even if you think it, why
would you say it out loud?
Besides, it's not even true,
you know. I like all sorts
of things, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
For example, {07 13 00}sometimes, I
like to be alone and stare

{07 06 00}I can be every bit as
